missing: Independently measured runtime from a major tester (RTINGS, Wirecutter) with a real CPAP and heated humidifier/tube. Also missing: real usable capacity after inverter loss and idle drain, and whether the unit's eco/low-load mode shuts off at CPAP draws. The sources' CPAP wattage assumptions range from about 7 W to 90 W, and none settles which figure applies to the shopper's own machine.
why: No major reviewer or authority is in the results. Many niche sites answer with nights-per-charge tables, but most are calculated rather than tested and their wattage assumptions conflict. That leaves it contested, not saturated or open.
